Admins can now create teams from a new Teams page at `/app/teams`. I haven't run any tests, lint, type checks or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been exercised.

**What was added**
- **Create-team API:** `useCreateTeam` in `features/teams/api/create-team.ts` posts a name and description to `POST /teams`. Both fields are required. On success it refreshes the teams list and shows a "Team Created" notification.
- **Mock handler:** `POST /teams` in `testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts` requires a signed-in admin and saves the new team to the mock database.
- **Teams page:** `app/routes/app/teams.tsx` lists all teams with name, description and creation date. A Create Team button opens a form drawer with the two fields.
- **Navigation:** a "Teams" item in the side navigation, shown to admins only. The page itself also shows "Only admin can view this." to non-admins.
- **Test:** `app/routes/app/__tests__/teams.test.tsx` covers creating a team and seeing it in the list. It hasn't been run.

**Things to be aware of**
- **Notification placement:** the success notification is shown inside the mutation hook, as the project conventions require. The existing create-discussion code shows it in the component instead, so I didn't copy that.
- **Team scoping:** `GET /teams` returns every team and needs no sign-in, because registration uses it. Showing all teams to admins therefore doesn't match the product rule that users only see their own team. The roadmap already plans a Teams page for admins of several teams, so this may be intended, but you should confirm.
- **New team membership:** a created team has no members yet, since users belong to exactly one team and can't move.
